summary: AutoClaw Weekly Perks (Oct 12-16, UTC+8): on Oct 12 all users could claim 100M GLM-5.3-Flash tokens (expired at midnight Oct 12). From Oct 13 to 16, all users can log in each day to claim 8M GLM-5.3-Flash tokens (800 Credits); each daily reward expires at midnight on the day of claim. AutoClaw Monthly Subscription, Group Subscription and GLM Coding Plan Individual members can claim an additional daily reward by tier (5M-80M tokens). One claim per account per day; AutoClaw may revoke rewards for fraud or automated abuse.
claim_steps: Log in to AutoClaw after 12:00 AM (UTC+8) each day from Oct 13 to Oct 16
Claim the daily 8M GLM-5.3-Flash token reward and use it before midnight that day
